name: Kaela's Update
objectiveText: Bring the Venture Co. Letters to Kaela Shadowspear . Venture Co. Letters (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: kaela is at 59.66 on the map right next to wear this quest begins standing by the edge of the cliff
Leads to https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1084 and https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1083. Completing those 2 leads to https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1082.
This quest takes about 5 seconds to do, since the NPCs are almost adjacent. Worth 180 exp.

After the Covert ops: Alpha; and Beta, this quest is given.

It is also a prequest for two other quests, that
is so closely related they should be done simultaneously.

Firstly, they both include travelling to the charred vale, as well as back again.
Secondly, they are both needed to continue the thread.

The quests in question are:
Enraged Spirits and Wounded Ancients.

See under those quests for continuation.
